extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: The largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.citeAs: Bian, Y., Chen, X., Li, Z., Zhi, T., Sang, S., Luo, L., & Xu, Q. (2025). Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv:2510.20888v1.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We curated thousands of high-quality real images from the Internet and then used the existing 'zoo of specialist models' (commercial APIs and community LoRAs) as a powerful, automated engine to create our paired dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Matching each image to all compatible templates (some restrict subject categories).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Semantic conditions are defined by the visual effects templates (concept, style, motion, camera) used to generate the paired videos.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Accompanied by a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images of men, women, and children.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, 'deepfake' content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, leading to VAP potentially inheriting the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. Inaccurate semantic descriptions or large subject mismatch can degrade generation quality.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and testing for semantic-controlled video generation.
